capabilities: Lock notes or whole folders to open in reading view
Block editing with a strict lock that asks before allowing one-time edits
Lock and unlock items from the file explorer, note header, menus, or command palette
Review and change every lock in a settings list, including stale entries
disambiguation: Not a security or encryption tool; locks only prevent accidental edits inside Obsidian, not changes from other apps, sync, or plugins.
extras: Version 2.0 requires Obsidian 1.11 or newer and auto-converts 1.x locks on first start, saving a backup of the old settings.
problem: Obsidian opens notes in the same editing mode as everything else, so archived or reference notes can be changed by a stray keystroke.
summary: Note protection plugin that opens locked notes in reading view and can block editing entirely with a strict lock.
